specs.title: TC-01: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: 1. Open the login page /#/login
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu. It shows Login and not the email
4. Close the menu, then log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu. It shows the email and Logout

specs.title: TC-02: Add a product to the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list. The product, its price and Add to Basket are shown. Basket counter is 0
2. Click Add to Basket. A message shows and the basket counter is 1
3. Open the basket. It has one row with the name, quantity 1 and price 8.99¤
4. The basket shows Total Price: 8.99¤

steps.title: Part 1 / 1. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address and click Continue
Part 1 / 2. Select Standard Delivery and click Continue. Wallet balance 5.00 and Pay 8.99¤ are shown
Part 1 / 3. The Pay 8.99¤ button is disabled
Part 1 / 4. Order History says there are no orders yet
Part 1 / 5. Digital Wallet shows balance 5.00
Part 2 / 6. Go to the payment page with Standard Delivery. Wallet balance 8.99 and an enabled Pay 8.99¤
Part 2 / 7. Click Pay 8.99¤. The order summary shows Digital Wallet and Total Price 8.99¤
Part 2 / 8. Click Place your order and pay. The confirmation page shows the thank you text
Part 2 / 9. Digital Wallet shows balance 1.00 (8.99 - 8.99 + 1 bonus point)
Part 2 / 10. Order History shows the order with Total Price 8.99¤ and Bonus 1
